title: Airbnb Booking System: Complete Design
description: Design airbnb booking system with OOP principles, class diagrams, and scalable C# implementations.

data.text: Design a airbnb booking system using object-oriented principles. Focus on clean class design, proper encapsulation, and extensible architecture.

data.caption: Interaction flow for Airbnb Booking System. Shows how components collaborate to fulfill a user request.
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as AirbnbBookingSystemService
    participant US as User
    participant IT as Item
    participant BO as Booking
    participant PA as Payment

    C->>S: Request
    S->>IT: Search()
    IT-->>S: Result
    S->>BO: Book()
    BO-->>S: Result
    S->>PA: Cancel()
    PA-->>S: Result
    S->>PA: Pay()

data.title: airbnb-booking.Advanced.cs — Processor Pipeline
Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Airbnb Booking System demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
